items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: But he always would get me in the play. Like Peter Boca or Narendra Teoh or Allen Godun.

ctx.x: So you were with him almost to the end, huh?

Over in there? Yeah. We had some fun. Allen used to come over when we wasn't playing. I had the car living up on who's in there and everything. He used to, I used to drink the wine too. So one, one more man in front of him. I said, who is that? Me. He's brown law. I said, come on in. I said, come on in. I'll get some out and we'll talk. We'll have some fun. I said, all right. I said, well let's get through. Put some clothes on. I got through. I got through. Put some clothes. And me and them got in the car. And me…
I used to enjoy hearing him. I guess I heard you play with him but I forgot. Yeah.
